watches.name: 39 mm Sandon Indigo
watches.description: Distinctive colour. Timeless design. Canadian craftsmanship. A colourful interpretation of our classic Sandon, featuring a rich indigo dial, polished stainless steel case and a choice of signature crown designs. Powered by a Japanese Miyota automatic movement and finished with sapphire crystals and your choice of sailcloth or handcrafted leather strap, the 39 mm Sandon Indigo combines timeless styling with distinctive Canadian craftsmanship. The Sandon Indigo brings a rich, vibrant colour to our classic Sandon collection, first introduced in black and white in 2021. Combining distinctive styling with everyday versatility, this 39 mm automatic watch offers a fresh interpretation of our original design. Designed and hand-assembled in Canada, the Sandon Indigo blends timeless aesthetics with the durability and reliability of a precision mechanical timepiece. Powered by the acclaimed Japanese Miyota 9015 automatic movement, it winds naturally with the motion of your wrist—no batteries or charging required. The polished 316L stainless steel case features contrasting brushed sides, creating a refined balance of textures that complements the deep indigo dial. Scratch-resistant sapphire crystals on the front and back offer exceptional clarity, while the exhibition case back reveals the intricate workings of the automatic movement. For a distinctive finishing touch, the crown is available with either an enamel-inlaid red maple leaf—a subtle tribute to the watch's Canadian origins—or our engraved BG logo. The Sandon Indigo can be fitted with your choice of a durable sailcloth strap or a handcrafted genuine leather strap, each complemented by a stainless steel deployant clasp for a comfortable, secure fit. With water resistance to 50 metres, robust construction and a dependable mechanical movement, the 39 mm Sandon Indigo combines timeless design with a confident touch of colour, creating a versatile timepiece designed to be worn and enjoyed every day. watches.name: Modern Classic
watches.description: Vintage Swiss craftsmanship. Contemporary Canadian design. A contemporary Canadian-made timepiece featuring an authentic, individually restored Swiss mechanical movement from the 1940s or 1950s. Combining vintage watchmaking heritage with modern stainless steel construction and sapphire crystals, the Modern Classic is a distinctive expression of timeless design. Produced in limited quantities. First introduced in 2010, the Modern Classic quickly became one of our most admired timepieces. Production was discontinued in 2020 as vintage movements and replacement parts became increasingly difficult to source. However, continued demand for this distinctive watch inspired us to seek out new sources for these historic components, allowing us to reintroduce the Modern Classic in limited quantities. At the heart of each Modern Classic is an authentic Swiss-made mechanical movement, originally produced for Bulova pocket watches in the 1940s and 1950s. Every movement is individually sourced and painstakingly restored through a complete process of disassembly, cleaning, inspection and refurbishment. Once reassembled and lubricated, each movement is carefully adjusted and tested for accuracy. These remarkable examples of traditional Swiss watchmaking are housed in a contemporary 316L stainless steel case, featuring a domed sapphire crystal and a sapphire exhibition back that reveals the intricate workings of the restored movement. A fine leather strap with a stainless steel deployant clasp completes the understated design. The result is a distinctive union of vintage craftsmanship and contemporary design—a timepiece that brings more than eight decades of watchmaking heritage to the wrist. Limited Production Sourcing and restoring these increasingly rare movements is a meticulous and time-consuming process. As a result, only a limited number of Modern Classic watches can be produced each year. Please contact us to enquire about availability or to be added to our waiting list. The Character of a Vintage Movement Each Modern Classic carries its own history. The restored movements retain the subtle surface marks, scratches and patina acquired over decades of service. These characteristics are a natural part of their heritage and lend each watch a character all its own. During restoration, all functional components, including the jewels, are carefully cleaned and inspected, with worn or damaged parts replaced as necessary. A note on care: Unlike contemporary wristwatch movements, these vintage pocket watch mechanisms were not equipped with modern shock protection. Although the stainless steel case is manufactured to contemporary standards and provides water resistance to 30 metres, the movement remains sensitive to sudden impacts. The Modern Classic should therefore be handled with care and protected from drops and hard knocks. Specifications Case diameter: 41 mm Case thickness: 11 mm Case material: 316L stainless steel Water resistance: 30 metres / 3 ATM Movement: Vintage Swiss ETA 951/953, Bulova-branded Winding: Manual Jewels: 17 Hands: Black gunmetal finish with white luminous insets Front crystal: Domed sapphire Case back: Sapphire exhibition back with flat crystal Strap: Leather Clasp: Stainless steel deployant Our Guarantee Every Barrington Griffiths watch is backed by a one-year warranty against defects in materials and workmanship, together with a 14-day satisfaction guarantee. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, simply return your watch within 14 days for a full refund. Made in Canada. All prices are in Canadian dollars.

watches.name: Canadian Ski Patrol
watches.description: Purpose-built performance. Canadian craftsmanship. Created in collaboration with the Canadian Ski Patrol, this individually numbered 39 mm automatic watch combines rugged stainless steel construction with practical details designed for active use. Featuring luminous hands, numerals and seconds hand, sapphire crystals, and a black sailcloth strap with distinctive red stitching, the Canadian Ski Patrol Edition celebrates the dedication and spirit of Canada's volunteer ski patrollers. Inspired by the dedication and resilience of the Canadian Ski Patrol, this special edition Sandon combines rugged durability, dependable mechanical performance and refined design. Created for those who work and play in Canada's most demanding conditions, it is a distinctive timepiece that celebrates the spirit of the Canadian outdoors. Designed and hand-assembled in Calgary, Alberta, the Canadian Ski Patrol Edition is powered by the acclaimed Japanese Miyota 9015 automatic movement. Winding naturally with the motion of your wrist, it delivers reliable mechanical performance without the need for batteries or charging. The 39 mm case is crafted from 316L stainless steel, with polished surfaces and contrasting brushed sides. Scratch-resistant sapphire crystals on the front and back provide exceptional clarity and durability, while the exhibition case back reveals the intricate workings of the automatic movement. Designed with functionality in mind, luminous hands, numerals and hour markers provide excellent legibility in low-light conditions. A luminous-tipped seconds hand offers an immediate visual indication that the movement is running—a practical detail for patrol members who depend on their watches in the field. Proudly displaying the Canadian Ski Patrol insignia, the watch is complemented by a durable black sailcloth strap with distinctive red stitching and a stainless steel deployant clasp. Comfortable and secure, the strap accommodates wrist sizes from 175 to 215 mm. Each Canadian Ski Patrol Edition is individually numbered, making every watch a unique part of this special series. With water resistance to 50 metres, robust construction and a dependable automatic movement, the Canadian Ski Patrol Edition is designed for active lifestyles, combining practical functionality with timeless Canadian craftsmanship.
